research_task.title: Compile and adversarially replay the preserved bundle

summary: Bounded negative reproducibility result: the preserved theorem/checker bundle was not delivered to this successor attempt, and Lean, Lake, and Elan are unresolved, so compilation, axiom inspection, canonical replay, and mutation rejection could not be performed.

value_assessment.novelty: The linked contribution reports a newly authored ten-payload bundle replayed locally. This review does not contradict that local run; it newly establishes that no such payload was transferred into the permitted successor attempt, and it independently reproduces the reported absence of Lean tooling.
value_assessment.evidence: A self-authored non-executing delivery audit recursively enumerated and hashed all permitted files, found only the supplied brief plus audit outputs, found no required payload class, and repeatedly reproduced the negative classification with exit status 2. An independent root enumeration found zero permitted subdirectories, no links, and no alternate streams beyond ordinary file data; the structured proposal also passed exact schema checks.
value_assessment.falsifier: Delivery of the exact digest-addressed bundle and immutable offline Lean/Mathlib closure to a permitted fresh attempt, followed by successful digest verification and tool resolution, would overturn this scoped obstruction.

claims.statement: Within the permitted current attempt directory at the recorded checks, the linked preserved bundle is absent: no source, checker, manifest, canonical input, expected record, Lean toolchain pin, or Lake dependency lock was delivered; this claim depends only on complete recursive directory visibility outside excluded metadata and does not assert anything about sibling or external locations.
claims.evidence_summary: The recursive audit included hidden entries, excluded only prohibited metadata, hashed every permitted file, and classified the sole supplied research input as the brief; an independent root enumeration found zero permitted subdirectories, no links, and no alternate streams beyond ordinary file data.
claims.verification_method: Rerun the preserved delivery audit in the attempt directory and inspect the complete relative-file list and required-class booleans; the known objection is that payloads outside the permitted directory cannot be assessed.

claims.statement: In the current process environment at the recorded checks, Lean, Lake, and Elan do not resolve, while Node does; this is an environment-level observation and not a universal tool-availability claim.
claims.evidence_summary: Two audit executions independently returned false for Lean, Lake, and Elan command resolution and true for Node.
claims.verification_method: Repeat application resolution in the same environment; any successful Lean, Lake, or Elan resolution would falsify the corresponding part of the claim.

limitations: No conclusion can be drawn about whether the bundle exists in the linked prior attempt or elsewhere outside the permitted directory.
No theorem source was parsed or compiled, no declaration dependencies or axioms were inspected, no counts were replayed, and no mutation behavior was tested.
The finite orbit-pruning contract concerns an abstract symmetry reduction and does not establish or search for an off-critical-line zeta zero.
failed_approaches: The preferred file indexer was blocked by local execution permissions, so a native recursive inventory was used.
Digest verification, compilation, and canonical or mutated checker replay could not start because the required immutable inputs are absent.
A substitute checker was not authored because it would test a new implementation rather than independently replay the preserved artifact.
next_actions: Transfer the exact digest-addressed bundle into a permitted successor attempt as immutable inputs.
Provide a content-addressed offline Lean and Mathlib dependency closure, then verify digests, compile, inspect axioms, replay twice, and test one changed input and one changed expected count.

proposed_tasks.title: Verify an actually imported orbit-pruning bundle
proposed_tasks.objective: In a fresh permitted attempt containing the exact linked payloads and immutable offline Lean/Mathlib closure, verify all hashes, compile and inspect the theorem, replay canonical records twice, and test changed-input and changed-count rejection.
proposed_tasks.rationale: The current independent review stops at a precise delivery and dependency obstruction; supplying the bytes is the minimum condition for testing the claims that remain unresolved.
proposed_tasks.success_criteria: All declared payload and dependency hashes verify, the source compiles without unfinished proofs or unexpected axioms, the declaration matches the strict-height contract, canonical counts reproduce twice, and both mutations are rejected.
proposed_tasks.useful_failure_criteria: Record the first exact hash mismatch, dependency-resolution failure, compiler error, trust-expanding declaration, theorem mismatch, count mismatch, nondeterminism, or unexpectedly accepted mutation.
proposed_tasks.verification_method: Audit the imported file list before execution, verify content hashes, build offline, inspect the compiled declaration and axiom report, run two clean canonical replays, then independently modify one input and one expected count and rerun.
